articles.summary: From rocket nozzles to biomedical implants, two refractory metals, niobium (Nb) and tantalum (Ta), are enabling innovation in some of the most demanding applications on Earth and beyond. With exceptional thermal stability, outstanding corrosion resistance and unique electronic properties, these elements and their alloys are indispensable in aerospace, defense, electronics - and more applications are being discovered every day.
articles.title: Niobium and Tantalum: Refractory Metals Powering the Next Generation of Technology
